```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinyjs)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

# Define state pairs with exact naming that matches your image files
state_pairs <- list(
  # Mental illness pairs
  list(name = "MISSISSIPPI_LOUISIANA", display_name = "Mississippi vs Louisiana", 
       category = "Mentally Ill", vis_type = "overlaid"),
  list(name = "NORTH CAROLINA_TENNESSEE", display_name = "North Carolina vs Tennessee", 
       category = "Mentally Ill", vis_type = "polar"),
  list(name = "ALABAMA_GEORGIA", display_name = "Alabama vs Georgia", 
       category = "Mentally Ill", vis_type = "dodged"),
  list(name = "FLORIDA_DELAWARE", display_name = "Florida vs Delaware", 
       category = "Mentally Ill", vis_type = "overlaid"),
  list(name = "MISSOURI_OHIO", display_name = "Missouri vs Ohio", 
       category = "Mentally Ill", vis_type = "polar"),
  
  # Developmentally disabled pairs
  list(name = "MAINE_KENTUCKY", display_name = "Maine vs Kentucky", 
       category = "Developmentally Disabled", vis_type = "dodged"),
  list(name = "ARKANSAS_MINNESOTA", display_name = "Arkansas vs Minnesota", 
       category = "Developmentally Disabled", vis_type = "overlaid"),
  list(name = "WISCONSIN_MARYLAND", display_name = "Wisconsin vs Maryland", 
       category = "Developmentally Disabled", vis_type = "polar"),
  list(name = "CONNECTICUT_IOWA", display_name = "Connecticut vs Iowa", 
       category = "Developmentally Disabled", vis_type = "dodged")
)

# Create a list of instructions for each judgment (27 total)
judgment_instructions <- list(
  "1" = "Instruction a: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Mississippi from 1870 to 1860",
  "2" = "Instruction b: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Louisiana from 1860 to 1870",
  "3" = "Instruction c: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Mississippi in 1860 to Louisiana in 1870",
  "4" = "Instruction d: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in North Carolina in 1860 to 1870",
  "5" = "Instruction e: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Tennessee in 1860 to 1870",
  "6" = "Instruction f: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in North Carolina in 1860 to Tennessee in 1860",
  "7" = "Instruction g: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Alabama in 1860 to 1870",
  "8" = "Instruction h: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Georgia in 1860 to 1870",
  "9" = "Instruction i: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Alabama in 1870 to Georgia in 1870",
  "10" = "Instruction j: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Florida in 1860 to 1870",
  "11" = "Instruction k: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Delaware in 1860 to 1870",
  "12" = "Instruction l: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Florida in 1870 to Delaware in 1870",
  "13" = "Instruction m: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Missouri in 1860 to 1870",
  "14" = "Instruction n: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Ohio in 1860 to 1870",
  "15" = "Instruction o: Find the ratio of mentally ill people in Missouri in 1870 to Ohio in 1870",
  "16" = "Instruction p: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Maine in 1870 to 1860",
  "17" = "Instruction q: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Kentucky in 1860 to 1870",
  "18" = "Instruction r: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Maine in 1870 to Kentucky in 1870",
  "19" = "Instruction s: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Arkansas in 1860 to 1870",
  "20" = "Instruction t: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Minnesota in 1860 to 1870",
  "21" = "Instruction u: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Arkansas in 1870 to Minnesota in 1870",
  "22" = "Instruction v: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Wisconsin in 1860 to 1870",
  "23" = "Instruction w: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Maryland in 1860 to 1870",
  "24" = "Instruction x: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Wisconsin in 1860 to Maryland in 1860",
  "25" = "Instruction y: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Connecticut in 1860 to 1870",
  "26" = "Instruction z: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Iowa in 1860 to 1870",
  "27" = "Final instruction: Find the ratio of developmentally disabled people in Connecticut in 1870 to Iowa in 1870"
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  useShinyjs(),
  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
      .instruction-box {
        background-color: #f8f9fa;
        border-left: 5px solid #007bff;
        padding: 15px;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        border-radius: 5px;
        font-size: 16px;
        font-weight: bold;
      }
    "))
  ),
  div(
    id = "login_page",
    style = "width: 300px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding-top: 50px;",
    wellPanel(
      h2("Enter Your Name", class = "text-center"),
      textInput("user_name", "Your Name:", placeholder = "First Last"),
      actionButton("login_btn", "Start Assessment", class = "btn-primary btn-block")
    )
  ),
  hidden(
    div(
      id = "explanation_page",
      style = "width: 800px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding-top: 20px;",
      wellPanel(
        h2("Experiment Instructions", class = "text-center"),
        h3("Understanding Ratio Judgments"),
        p("In this experiment, you'll be comparing visualizations showing mental illness rates between pairs of states."),
        p("Your task is to estimate the ratio between the two states' values by adjusting the slider."),
        h3("Example"),
        imageOutput("example_chart", height = "400px"),
        p("For this example visualization, we want you to estimate the ratio of the number in 1860 to 1870"),
        sliderInput("example_ratio", "Example Ratio:", 
                   min = 0, max = 1, value = 0.5, step = 0.01),
        actionButton("submit_example", "Submit Example", class = "btn-primary"),
        
        hidden(
          div(
            id = "feedback_section",
            h3("Feedback"),
            textOutput("true_ratio_feedback"),
            actionButton("proceed_btn", "Proceed to Experiment", class = "btn-success")
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  hidden(
    div(
      id = "main_app",
      titlePanel("Image Ratio Assessment Tool"),
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          h3(textOutput("welcome_message")),
          # Instruction box
          div(
            class = "instruction-box",
            textOutput("current_instruction")
          ),
          uiOutput("ratio_slider_ui"),
          actionButton("save_btn", "Save Assessment", class = "btn-primary"),
          br(), br(),
          actionButton("logout_btn", "Sign Out", class = "btn-warning"),
          br(), br(),
          h4("Completion Status"),
          textOutput("progress_text"),
          h4("Current Visualization:"),
          textOutput("current_vis_type")
        ),
        mainPanel(
          imageOutput("display_image", height = "500px")
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Database connection
  con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "Practice_assessments_group.db")
  
  output$example_chart <- renderImage({
    list(
      src = file.path("pair_plots_original_style", "dodged_example.png"),
      contentType = "image/png",
      width = "100%",
      alt = "Example dodged bar chart"
    )
  }, deleteFile = FALSE)
  
  # Create fresh tables
  dbExecute(con, "
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_name TEXT UNIQUE,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  ")
  
  dbExecute(con, "
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assessments (
      assessment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER,
      pair_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      pair_display TEXT NOT NULL,
      vis_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      ratio REAL NOT NULL,
      judgment_num INTEGER NOT NULL,
      timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
    )
  ")
  
  # Reactive values
  user <- reactiveValues(id = NULL, name = NULL, authenticated = FALSE)
  current_pair_index <- reactiveVal(1)
  judgment_num <- reactiveVal(1)
  
  # Current pair info
  current_pair <- reactive({
    state_pairs[[current_pair_index()]]
  })
  
  # Current instruction text
  output$current_instruction <- renderText({
    req(user$authenticated)
    judgment_id <- (current_pair_index() - 1) * 3 + judgment_num()
    judgment_instructions[[as.character(judgment_id)]]
  })
  
  # Dynamic slider
  output$ratio_slider_ui <- renderUI({
    req(user$authenticated)
    sliderInput("ratio_slider", 
               label = paste("Ratio for", current_pair()$display_name),
               min = 0, max = 1, value = 0.5, step = 0.01)
  })
  
  # Current visualization type
  output$current_vis_type <- renderText({
    paste("Type:", current_pair()$vis_type)
  })
  
  # Welcome message
  output$welcome_message <- renderText({
    req(user$authenticated)
    paste("Welcome,", user$name)
  })
  
  # Progress text
  output$progress_text <- renderText({
    req(user$authenticated)
    paste("Pair", current_pair_index(), "of", length(state_pairs),
          "- Judgment", judgment_num(), "of 3")
  })
  
  # True ratio feedback for example
  output$true_ratio_feedback <- renderText({
    "The true ratio for this example was 0.65. This is because the 1860 data had a count of 130 and the 1870 data had a count of 200. By taking 130/200, we get .65 making a true ratio of .65"
  })
  
  # Image display with thorough error checking
  output$display_image <- renderImage({
    req(user$authenticated)
    
    pair <- current_pair()$name
    vis_type <- current_pair()$vis_type
    category <- current_pair()$category
    
    # Construct the filename based on your naming pattern
    filename <- paste0(category, "_", pair, "_", vis_type, ".png")
    img_path <- file.path("pair_plots_original_style", filename)
    
    # Check if file exists
    if (!file.exists(img_path)) {
      # Try alternative naming patterns if needed
      alt_filename <- paste0(gsub(" ", "_", category), "_", pair, "_", vis_type, ".png")
      img_path <- file.path("pair_plots_original_style", alt_filename)
      
      if (!file.exists(img_path)) {
        # Fallback to placeholder if still not found
        img_path <- file.path("pair_plots_original_style", "placeholder.png")
      }
    }
    
    # Return the image
    list(
      src = img_path,
      contentType = "image/png",
      width = "100%",
      alt = paste(pair, "visualization")
    )
  }, deleteFile = FALSE)
  
  # Login handler
  observeEvent(input$login_btn, {
    req(input$user_name)
    
    tryCatch({
      user$name <- trimws(input$user_name)
      if (user$name == "") stop("Please enter your name")
      
      # Find or create user
      user_exists <- dbGetQuery(con, 
                              "SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_name = ?",
                              params = list(user$name))
      
      if (nrow(user_exists) == 0) {
        dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO users (user_name) VALUES (?)", 
                 params = list(user$name))
        user$id <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT last_insert_rowid()")[[1]]
      } else {
        user$id <- user_exists$user_id[1]
      }
      
      shinyjs::hide("login_page")
      shinyjs::show("explanation_page")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
  })
  
  # Submit example handler
  observeEvent(input$submit_example, {
    shinyjs::show("feedback_section")
  })
  
  # Proceed to experiment handler
  observeEvent(input$proceed_btn, {
    user$authenticated <- TRUE
    shinyjs::hide("explanation_page")
    shinyjs::show("main_app")
    judgment_num(1)
  })
  
  # Save handler
  observeEvent(input$save_btn, {
    req(user$authenticated)
    
    tryCatch({
      # Save current judgment
      dbExecute(con,
               "INSERT INTO assessments 
                (user_id, pair_name, pair_display, vis_type, ratio, judgment_num) 
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
               params = list(
                 user$id,
                 current_pair()$name,
                 current_pair()$display_name,
                 current_pair()$vis_type,
                 input$ratio_slider,
                 judgment_num()
               ))
      
      # Update judgment counter
      if (judgment_num() < 3) {
        judgment_num(judgment_num() + 1)
      } else {
        # Move to next pair after 3 judgments
        if (current_pair_index() < length(state_pairs)) {
          current_pair_index(current_pair_index() + 1)
          judgment_num(1)
        } else {
          showNotification("All assessments completed!", type = "message")
          shinyjs::disable("save_btn")
        }
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Save failed:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
  })
  
  # Logout handler
  observeEvent(input$logout_btn, {
    user$id <- NULL
    user$name <- NULL
    user$authenticated <- FALSE
    shinyjs::reset("login_page")
    shinyjs::show("login_page")
    shinyjs::hide("main_app")
    shinyjs::hide("explanation_page")
    current_pair_index(1)
    judgment_num(1)
  })
  
  # Cleanup
  onStop(function() {
    dbDisconnect(con)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
